entries.what: Walked to Alcaraz Flats High and got through AP Calc and APUSH, then stayed at the library homework center to do two timed SAT practice sections with a kitchen timer.
entries.outcome: Finished both sections and marked the misses.

entries.what: Did dishes after dinner and checked that Lola Cora ate her lunch leftovers, then tweaked the college list spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Dishes done, Lola fine.

entries.what: Wrote in the essay file on Ramón's old desktop past midnight.
entries.outcome: Trimmed one paragraph but left the draft unsent.

entries.what: Went through school classes, then sat at the library for homework and a quick check of SAT test-day logistics.
entries.outcome: Printed the admission ticket for free.

entries.what: Robotics in room C7 from 3:30 to 6, working on the mechanical subteam's drivetrain with Lucas nearby.
entries.outcome: Got the gearbox assembled.

entries.what: Ate dinner with the family; Grace asked about SAT sleep plans and Isabel answered curtly.
entries.outcome: Brief tense exchange, no fight.

entries.what: Morning run around the Delgado Park loop before school, then classes.
entries.outcome: Felt good, three-mornings quota met.

entries.what: Tutored Mateo at Kessler Middle from 4 to 5 on fractions and ratios, earning $20.
entries.outcome: Mateo got three problems right in a row; she put the $20 toward her application fee fund.

entries.what: Put the egret count date, Saturday Nov 15 at 7 a.m. at the boardwalk trailhead, on her wall calendar after the volunteer group's email.
entries.outcome: Date locked in.

entries.what: Robotics build session in C7; Lucas mentioned he is applying early decision to the top engineering school on her list.
entries.outcome: She said little and filed it away.

entries.what: Studied AP Chem problem sets at the library until closing.
entries.outcome: Finished the set.

entries.what: Late-night essay tinkering and a short email to Mr. Kim to confirm the Oct 7 meeting.
entries.outcome: Mr. Kim replied after 10 p.m., confirming.

entries.what: At lunch and after school she kept thinking about Lucas's early decision plan and decided to ask whether she should switch to early decision too, two weeks before deadlines.
entries.outcome: Nadia told her to sleep on it; she still sat up researching ED versus EA that night.

entries.what: Went with Nadia in her brother's beige sedan to boba at Cloud Nine, ordering jasmine milk tea, 30% sugar, no ice.
entries.outcome: Quick break before the SAT.

entries.what: Packed her SAT bag with calculator, pencils and ticket, and went to bed earlier than usual.
entries.outcome: Asleep by 11:30.

entries.what: Took the SAT at Tamsen Valley College, getting a ride from Grace in the early morning.
entries.outcome: Finished all sections; the math felt solid.

entries.what: Skipped Harper's library session since prep was over, and ate lunch at home with Lola Cora.
entries.outcome: Lola made her eat extra.

entries.what: Slept off the test, then looked at the essay file without changing anything.
entries.outcome: Closed it.

entries.what: Went to Sunday Tagalog Mass with Lola Cora and Grace, then ate sinigang at home.
entries.outcome: Ate two bowls while acting indifferent.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon on homework and prepping questions for the Oct 7 meeting with Mr. Kim.
entries.outcome: Wrote a short list of questions.

entries.what: Did dishes and chatted briefly with Ramón, who was home, about the SAT.
entries.outcome: He told her not to stress about the score.
